subtopics.title: Setting Up Python Environment
subtopics.description: Learn how to install Python, set up a virtual environment, and install necessary packages for Django development. Understand the importance of a clean environment for consistent project development.

subtopics.title: Creating and Configuring a Django Project
subtopics.description: Discover how to create a new Django project, configure settings, manage databases, and set up middleware and authentication. Explore the structure and purpose of each configuration file.
